notes: Source is the Mistral Docs model page (https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/ministral-3-14b-25-12). It is a product/model catalog page (release date, context, license, params, features, pricing), not a safety system card: no risk tiers, no safety topics, no numeric eval tables. Readable text was rebuilt from HTML/RSC flight data because the page is client-rendered. Weights show Parameters/Active 14B and context 256k for Instruct, Reasoning, and Base. Modalities Text input / Image input / Text output come from the modality icons' accessible labels in the RSC payload. The separate Ministral 3 arXiv technical report (seed key mistral-ministral-3-paper) and legal.mistral.ai lifecycle page were not used as sources; seed-lookup listed only this document. No pageCount (web page). alsoDocuments empty per seed-lookup.
